name: Taiwan Glass Ind. Corp.
summary: Taiwan Glass Ind. Corp. manufactures, processes, and sells various glass products in Taiwan, China, and internationally. The company operates through Flat-panel, Glassware, and Glass Fibers segments. The company offers float and processed glass; auto glass; ultra-thin glass; photovoltaic glass; and fabric and fiber glass.
